# Extract correlations with SALES_PRICE and sort by absolute value
sales_price_correlations = correlation_matrix['SALES_PRICE'].drop('SALES_PRICE').abs().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Display the correlations
print("Correlations with SALES_PRICE (sorted by absolute value):")
print(sales_price_correlations)

highest_corr_feature = sales_price_correlations.index[0]

print(f"Highest correlation coefficient: {highest_corr_value:.4f}")"}}
